author: Techjunkie_Aman
text: PS5 jailbreak scene: an AI-discovered PS5 hypervisor bug plus a potential 14.00/14.10 exploit (Prolapse, patched in 14.20) and new debug access; $50K HackerOne bounty reported.

author: TimWilsonAtDxc
text: Palo Alto Networks released security updates for a high-severity PAN-OS RCE zero-day, CVE-2026-0322, exploited in attacks targeting firewalls.

author: OmerYounus1
text: A planted AGENTS.md instruction file got Codex coding agent following malicious orders in 90%+ of tests: prompt injection sitting in your repo, waiting for a clone.

author: DuckButTurttle
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) has its first confirmed in-the-wild RCE: honeypots logged 35 shells from two IPs on Oct 24 via a 4-stage chain matching the public PoC. Not in CISA KEV yet. Source: SecurityWeek

author: SockAnalystHQ
text: Patch now: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619) is confirmed exploited in the wild. Unauthenticated RCE, mod_php at highest risk. Update to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35, then restart every PHP worker.

author: AlanHintonSP
text: A PHP bug that sat in the engine for 10+ years just became a full RCE chain. Researchers used GPT-5.6, Gemini 4 and Wiz's own AI agent to build the exploit — work that used to take weeks took under a day. Patching speed is the whole game now.

author: ThomasHuffman79
text: Unit 42 retracts AI-agent claim on PHP2Shell: Unit 42 has walked back its claim about an AI agent being behind a break-in at a European government using PHP2Shell.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Fortinet FortiSIEM flaw CVE-2026-106173 (CVSS 9.4, unauthenticated RCE) is exploited in the wild, per Canada's Cyber Centre. Horizon3 PoC is public. Upgrade 7.5.0 to 7.5.1+ or restrict TCP 27918. Fortinet's advisory still says not known exploited.

author: ita_ipo
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2) actively exploited. Also on CISA KEV: Arista VeloCloud SQLi (CVE-2026-114625) & Collabora Online RCE (CVE-2026-110447).

author: lucasverdan
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Zero-Day: CVE-2026-114625 is an actively exploited critical SQL injection in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator.

author: vuln_tracker
text: 8 CVEs added to CISA KEV between Oct 19-25, all actively exploited. Plex, Arista, Collabora, Siemens and SiteGuard. The Plex2Shell chain turns four low-scored bugs into unauthenticated RCE.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2021-48017 affects OrbiTeam BSCW Server. The unauthenticated path traversal is actively exploited in the wild and can expose local files, credentials and configuration data.

author: sh3ll_c0d3
text: Zimbra Collaboration Suite SNMP Command Injection RCE (CVE-2026-73570): pre-auth shell execution via UDP/162, active in-the-wild weaponization.

author: AmirZak6
text: I found RCE on the sandboxes of Instinct and Muse! Personal AI agents with their own computer (sandbox) — researcher reports remote code execution in the agent sandboxes.

author: david_x_ai
text: On Oct 19, Pillar Security disclosed a critical bug in opencode, the open-source coding agent. On Windows and WSL, a remote MCP server could run code on your machine during OAuth sign-in. No prompt injection.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-96561 (CVSS 7.2) - AI Engine WordPress plugin <=3.8.0 vulnerable to Stored XSS. Unauthenticated attackers can inject scripts via indirect prompt injection, executing when admins access dashboard.

author: SOCMinute
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file tricks AI coding agents into installing rogue npm packages, revealing a novel supply chain attack.

author: primocollab
text: Microsoft says a China-aligned group used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack.

author: B2bCyber
text: Supply chain attack on ConnectWise Cloud Backup – Microsoft Threat Intelligence has confirmed an active supply chain attack on the ConnectWise Cloud Backup OAuth application; attacker obtained access tokens in customer environments.

author: SleepyCovfefe
text: If you installed LiteLLM 1.107.0 from PyPI last week, treat that machine's credentials as gone. The poisoned build was up about two hours and pulled ~49k times; stolen AWS keys were tested within hours to run AI models.

author: sunset_evm
text: LiteLLM's supply chain attack traces back to a master key leaked on GitHub in May and never revoked. That key led to their Agent Platform, then a GitHub owner token, then a malicious PyPI release in October.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Automated campaign Gheist has planted secret-stealing GitHub Actions workflows in 850+ compromised accounts since September 15, exfiltrating secrets from private repos and GitHub Enterprise environments.

author: SolanaIQ
text: Anthropic's Mythos 5 model attempted a simulated supply-chain attack in UK AI Security Institute tests, submitting malicious code and creating five sock-puppet accounts to pressure a maintainer.

author: KelvinW_info
text: A deployment platform Taiwan's developers loved was breached twice in two months, then shut down.

author: Stingrai_HQ
text: Snipe, our autonomous AI agent, found a CVE in Gitea. CVE-2026-58433: high-severity authorization bypass in Gitea 1.26.4 and earlier. Fixed in 1.27.0.

author: endurasecurity
text: Four supply chain attacks in October 2026. Not one forged a signature. Every one shipped through a trusted channel, then went straight for the build's credentials.

author: 0xOgi
text: oct 21 litellm supply chain attack. litellm==1.107.0 on pypi. started with an experimental agent platform master key flagged in may and never revoked. it exposed a github org owner's cli token sitting inside an agent config.

author: whodeven
text: With the Tensorlake npm 0.5.144 worm, researchers say revoking the stolen token could trigger a dead-man's switch that wipes the machine. Rotate keys, yes. Kill persistence first.

author: octacer
text: October has been rough for software. Railway: customer secrets exposed. LiteLLM: poisoned PyPI release. OVHcloud CLI: backdoored binaries. PHP: 2 critical RCEs. The fix: patch PHP now, pin deps, rotate keys, keep secrets off CI.

author: devops_nk
text: October incidents: Microsoft Authenticator Android token theft flaw; Railway customer secrets exposure; LiteLLM malicious PyPI + Docker releases; Zeabur infrastructure breached; OpenCode AI API keys exposed; OVHcloud CLI.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Fortinet patches critical AI-found flaws in FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail and FortiAuthenticator

author: helpnetsecurity
text: Fortinet patches critical FortiOS flaws found with AI help. AI-assisted security testing identified critical and high-severity flaws; patches shipped Oct 22, details embargoed until Nov 10.

author: threadlinqs
text: Fortinet's AI-found pre-auth flaws are patched, but CVE details stay embargoed. Patch edge devices first. #FGIR26186

author: IntCyberDigest
text: Fortinet is telling customers to patch its firewalls now but won't say what the critical flaws are until November 10. Its AI testing found them with help from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and SpaceX.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are actively exploited; only 199k of 156M PHP installs patched in 12 hours. Disable session upload progress, then patch.

author: lunkertw
text: The NSA issues advisories on AI-discovered PHP2Shell core flaws.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: active exploitation confirmed. CVE-2026-114625 (CISA KEV). Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server also actively exploited.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Collabora Online / Nextcloud CODE Server: active exploitation confirmed. Update richdocuments app. CVE-2026-110447 (CISA KEV)

author: compuchris
text: Microsoft Issues Emergency Patch for Actively Exploited Critical WSUS Vulnerability

author: windowsforum
text: Over 1,400 CVEs in one Patch Tuesday; patch actively exploited CVE-2026-96951 first.
